health.collection_scope: Bounded 90-day issued-permit window, all permit types/statuses; count-checked deterministic pagination ordered by issue timestamp and row ID.
health.coverage_limitation: Not the full 664,565-row history. Closed/completed records remain evidence and are not admitted as current Signals. Applicant is not a buyer role. No construction start, project owner, temporary rental need, MW, supply gap, or authority is inferred; declared valuation and area are not power need. Status changes on records outside the recent issue window are not monitored.
